text:
sara: Quick heads-up — all-hands starting in 10m in main room. Agenda tweak: moving roadmap Q&A up to after the 1st demo (so we can respect folks' calendars). Recording + livestream to Zoom as usual. Please post any urgent questions here so we can queue them.

joseph-av: AV note — mic riser is acting flaky on stage 2, I'm swapping in backup capsule mic. If you're presenting, please do a mic check 5m before showtime.

alex: tiny ask — can we add a 2‑min intro slide about Dedicated pricing changes before roadmap? Just a single slide.

sara: yes, alex — drop the slide in #all-hands-deck channel now and we'll slot it. @julia can you confirm slide order?

julia: got it, moved alex's slide to slot 3. Also flag: Zoom live stream sometimes drops audio when presenters share screens with system audio. Use the "share computer sound" toggle in Zoom, or fallback to the presenter speaking into the mic.

mike: if audio drops, ops-bot can start a local OBS recording as fallback. @ops-bot start_local_recording — will that be automatic?

ops-bot: will not run unprompted. joseph-av will start local OBS as a manual fallback and upload to Google Drive post-meeting.

dina: question for leadership — where will the recording live and how long will we keep it? We had folks ask about 1yr vs 6mo retention.

sara: good Q — for now we keep all-hands recordings in Drive for 6 months; exports can be archived longer on request via comms@. We plan to add longer retention for leadership-approved sessions.

mike: during the last all-hands we saw a 30s desync between slides + audio for CDN viewers. Any tips to reduce that?

joseph-av: reduce bitrate spikes by not sharing full-screen browser tabs that autoplay heavy media. Also lower Zoom send resolution to 720p for the stream. I'll run that profile.

alex: moderation Q: who's fielding live Qs in chat and what counts as a priority question?

julia: I'll triage Zoom chat + Slack thread; alex will take product Qs, sara will take roadmap/business Qs, and mike will triage infra/reliability ones. Use the :question: reaction to mark priority.

dina: last thing — we had two requests to record raw presenter audio tracks for post-edit. Is that feasible?

joseph-av: feasible if presenters plug into stage mics and we record separate tracks in OBS multitrack. I'll need a list of volunteers now to route channels.

sara: volunteers so far: alex, mike, julia. Anyone else? Reply here.

mike: I'll double-check my laptop audio settings. If anyone's using a USB headset, pls bring a 3.5 adapter just in case.

julia: FYI I uploaded the final slide deck link: https://drive.google.com/rd/allhands-mar2026-deck. Please don't edit after 5m before start.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — 2 minutes until all-hands starts.

sara: thanks team. If recording hiccups happen we'll call an intercom pause and switch to local OBS — please stay on mute until we announce. See you in 10. :raised_hands:
